name: Falooda
description: Rose milk with vermicelli, basil seeds and a scoop of ice cream on top.

tcm.note: Iced dairy with rose and basil seed — cold throughout.

ayurveda.note: Shita by design: rose, sabja and milk are all cooling.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; a summer drink built to cool.

histamine.note: Low, though the ice cream and rose syrup add sugar rather than histamine.

nutrition.highlight: a drink you eat with a spoon
